title: Whole words
hints: strings.Count counts substrings, not words: "go" appears inside "gopher" and "ago" too.
Split the text into words first. strings.FieldsFunc(text, f) splits wherever f returns true, so make f return true for anything that isn't a letter or digit (unicode.IsLetter, unicode.IsDigit).
Compare each word with strings.EqualFold(w, word), which ignores case without building lowercase copies.
